title: Skittle's exploration
description: Just some exploration mods and some QOL
body:
Skittle’s Exploration is a vibrant adventure-focused Minecraft modpack built for players who crave discovery, danger, and endless variety. Journey through breathtaking biomes, uncover hidden ruins, and encounter mysterious creatures across a world packed with surprises. Whether you’re sailing into the unknown, building a cozy base in a distant land, or hunting for rare loot deep underground, every expedition feels rewarding.

With a carefully balanced mix of exploration, world generation, and quality-of-life improvements, Skittle’s Exploration transforms Minecraft into a colorful sandbox of adventure. Progress at your own pace — become a master explorer, or fearless treasure hunter.

Features include:

- Massive world generation overhaul with stunning landscapes
- New structures, improved survival mechanics and immersive gameplay
- Multiplayer-friendly experience with balanced progression

Pack your gear, gather your friends, and set out into a world where every direction holds a new adventure. Welcome to Skittle’s Exploration — the journey is just beginning.
